reproducible_examples.scope: Finite alternating, nonlinear canonical, semidirect-flow, marked-coordinate, homogeneous-rotation and cusp calculations. The general arguments are given in the editable lesson.

figure.coordinates: Samples of the exact rho=1 slice for -0.24<=r<=0.24: upper(r²,-2r³/3-r⁴/2), lower(r+r²,r²). Lower tangent at zero(1,0). Full conic embedding and primitive identity are proved in the lesson.
